emergence.summary: A single-gene MECP2 loss-of-function (X-linked, mostly de novo) removes the methyl-CpG-binding transcriptional regulator MeCP2 that is broadly required for post-natal neuronal maturation and synaptic regulation, so the MeCP2-dependent program is under-driven and that axis is forced DOWN. MECP2 is sharply DOSAGE-SENSITIVE in BOTH directions: too little causes Rett, too much causes a DISTINCT opposite-direction disorder (MECP2 duplication syndrome, OMIM 300260), so the corrective window is narrow and the corrective MAGNITUDE is especially [O]. Most lesions are coding/nonsense, OUTSIDE the promoter gamma firewall (like sickle cell's coding missense); gamma reads the MECP2 LOCUS switch structure. This entry nearly approaches SUSPENSION on dosage grounds, but the cause is a single readable locus with a forced LOF direction, so it RESOLVES with the dosage caveat made explicit. An approved therapy (trofinetide) acts DOWNSTREAM (IGF-1 / synaptic maturation) and does NOT restore MeCP2.
emergence.emergent_axis: MeCP2-dependent neuronal maturation / synaptic regulation program

per_gene.perturbation_reason: lineage threshold not reached -> program absent/reduced

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: MeCP2 is a methyl-CpG-binding transcriptional modulator broadly required for post-natal neuronal maturation and synaptic function; LOF (nonsense / missense / frameshift, X-linked) under-drives that program -> Rett. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; it does NOT encode the coding lesion (firewall). CAUTION -- dosage-sensitive in BOTH directions: MECP2 gain/duplication causes a DISTINCT opposite-direction disorder (MECP2 duplication syndrome, OMIM 300260), so the forced direction here is specific to the LOF (Rett) read and any correction must respect a narrow dosage window.

primary_switch.reason: lineage threshold not reached -> program absent/reduced

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

levers.push_direction: potentiate downstream IGF-1 / synaptic-maturation signalling to partially compensate for MeCP2 deficiency (does NOT restore MeCP2)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] downstream-compensation magnitude not derived from sequence; symptomatic -- does not correct the MeCP2 switch itself

levers.push_direction: deliver a DOSAGE-CONTROLLED functional MECP2 transgene -> restore MeCP2 toward the normal narrow window
levers.agent_class: dosage-regulated MECP2 gene transfer (investigational; e.g. mini-/feedback-regulated AAV-MECP2, TSHA-102, NGN-401)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] restored-MeCP2 level not derived from sequence; OVER-supply risks duplication-type toxicity -- correction must stay within a narrow dosage window
levers.src: Gadalla 2013 Mol Ther; Sinnett 2017 Mol Ther Methods Clin Dev; TSHA-102 / NGN-401 clinical programs

levers.push_direction: reactivate the silenced wild-type MECP2 allele on the inactive X -> restore endogenous, natively-regulated MeCP2
levers.agent_class: X-reactivation of the wild-type MECP2 allele (investigational)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] reactivation efficiency / cell fraction not derived from sequence; investigational
levers.src: Carrette 2018 PNAS 115:E668; Lyst & Bird 2015 Nat Rev Genet 16:261

levers.push_direction: promote read-through of a premature stop codon -> full-length MeCP2 (nonsense-allele subset only)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] read-through efficiency / MeCP2 recovery not derived from sequence; nonsense-allele subset only

lead_corrective_lever.push_direction: potentiate downstream IGF-1 / synaptic-maturation signalling to partially compensate for MeCP2 deficiency (does NOT restore MeCP2)
lead_corrective_lever.mechanism_grade: [O] downstream-compensation magnitude not derived from sequence; symptomatic -- does not correct the MeCP2 switch itself

modelling.grade: [F] ordering forced ; delta/treat_frac documented choices ; realised magnitude [O]

treatment_A_switch.firewall: levers are DIRECTION + cited agent CLASS; not dose/potency/efficacy/safety, not a recommendation to treat any individual.

falsifiers.claim: MECP2 LOF under-drives the MeCP2-dependent neuronal-maturation / synaptic axis (axis DOWN)
falsifiers.falsifier: a MECP2 null/LOF allele that PRESERVED or INCREASED MeCP2-dependent neuronal maturation/synaptic function would refute the LOF-under-drive direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: MeCP2-target synaptic/maturation readouts (dendritic complexity, synaptic markers, RTT-phenotype score) by genotype in a Mecp2-null model

falsifiers.claim: restoring MeCP2 within a narrow dosage window (replace / reactivate) is the CORRECTIVE direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if raising MeCP2 toward normal FAILED to improve the phenotype, or if OVER-restoration did NOT reproduce duplication-type toxicity, the dosage-restore model is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: RTT-phenotype rescue vs MeCP2 dosage (including over-expression) in a Mecp2-null model -- a dose-response with a window

gate_falsifiers.gate: falsifier register (>=1 measurable falsifier per disease)
